body.translated_text:

"Pay attention, Teacher. By this first factor I train in the training of those Noble <s>Arhats</s>, I follow their practice, I imitate them." (Upj(J) 17.3-5; 7.2-5; ~ Skt.C 43 v1-4; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 9 b1-4)

And it should be announced thus: when the entire <s>saṃgha</s> (community) is seated and assembled, or with a quorum, having performed the <s>samīcī</s> (preliminary act) three times, at the end of the senior monks, standing in a squatting position, with palms joined, the following should be said: "Venerable Ones, please give attention. children.translated_text: Thereafter the preceptor should be requested. And he should be requested thus: having performed the <s>samīcī</s>, standing in front in a squatting position, the following should be said: "Pay attention, Teacher. I, so-and-so by name, request the Teacher as my preceptor. May the Teacher be my preceptor. Under the Teacher as preceptor I shall go forth." This twice and a third time. But at the third utterance, one should say "preceptor." (Upj(J) 8.11-15; ~ Skt.C 44 r4-5; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 10 b2-4)

children.translated_text: Thereafter he should be ordained. And he should be ordained thus: "Pay attention, preceptor. I, so-and-so by name, go to the <s>Buddha</s> for refuge, the foremost of bipeds; I go to the <s>Dharma</s> for refuge, the foremost of things free from passion; I go to the <s>Saṃgha</s> for refuge, the foremost of assemblies. Following the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, the Lion of the <s>Śākyas</s>, the Supreme Lord of the <s>Śākyas</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Enlightened One, who has gone forth, I go forth. I abandon the mark of a householder and I adopt the mark of one gone forth." This twice and a third time. (Upj(J) 8.16-9.4; ~ Skt.C 44 r5-v1; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 11 a5-b4)

children.translated_text: Thereafter the saffron-colored robes should be given by the preceptor. He too should receive them falling at his feet. Then the preceptor should dress him and examine him to see whether he is without sexual characteristics, or has both sexual characteristics. The Blessed One said "He should be examined," so they examined him by stripping him naked. The Blessed One said: "He should not be examined by stripping him naked; rather, he should be examined unobtrusively while he is dressing." (Upj(J) 9.10-17; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 11 a3-5)

devānāṃ śabdaṃ śṛṇomi nāgānā

'I hear the sounds of <s>devas</s>, of <s>nāgas</s>,

alābhy eva sann anityasaṃjñāyā lābhy aham asmīty ātmānaṃ pratijānīte anitye duḥkhasaṃjñāyā

children.translated_text: of the perception of non-self in the suffering,

children.text: āhāre pratikūlasaṃjñāyāḥ sarvaloke 'nabhiratisaṃjñāyāḥ ādīnavasaṃjñāyāḥ prahāṇasaṃjñāyā virāgasaṃjñāyā nirodhasaṃjñāyā maraṇasaṃjñāyā (Upj(J) 24.15-18; ~ Skt.C 52 r6-v2; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 26 b5-27 a2; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 214.2-5)
children.translated_text: of the perception of repulsiveness in food, of the perception of non-delight in the entire world, of the perception of danger, of the perception of abandonment, of the perception of dispassion, of the perception of cessation, of the perception of death.' (Upj(J) 24.15-18; ~ Skt.C 52 r6-v2; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 26 b5-27 a2; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 214.2-5)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.2.3a
'Without actually having attained the perception of impermanence, he claims "I have attained it"; of the perception of suffering in the impermanent,

Uj III.ii.2.4.2.3b
alābhy eva sann aśubhasaṃjñāyāḥ lābhy aham asmīty ātmānaṃ pratijānīte vinīlakasaṃjñāyā vipūyakasaṃjñāyā

children.translated_text: the perception of the bloated, the perception of the bursting, the perception of the gnawed, the perception of the blood-splattered, the perception of the scat-

children.text: ptakasaṃjñāyā asthisaṃjñāyāḥ śūnyatāpratyavekṣaṇasaṃjñāyāḥ lābhy aham asmīty ātmānaṃ pratijānīte (Upj(J) 24.18-20; ~ Skt.C 52 v2-4; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 a2-3; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 214.5-8)
children.translated_text: tered, the perception of the skeleton, the perception of contemplation of emptiness — he claims "I have attained it."' (Upj(J) 24.18-20; ~ Skt.C 52 v2-4; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 a2-3; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 214.5-8)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.2.3b
'Without actually having attained the perception of the impure, he claims "I have attained it": the perception of the discolored, the perception of the festering,

body.text:

alābhy eva san* prathamasya dhyānasya dvitīyasya tṛtīyasya caturthasya dhyānasya maitryāḥ karuṇāyā muditāyā upekṣāyāḥ ākāśānantyāyata

children.translated_text: the base of infinite consciousness, the base of nothingness, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception; the fruit of stream-entry, the fruit of once-returning, the fruit of non-returning; the domain of supernatural powers, the divine ear, the knowledge of others' minds, the recollection of former lives, the knowledge of death and rebirth,

children.text: (Upj(J) 24.20-25; ~ Skt.C 52 v4-53 r1; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 a3-b1; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 214.8-12)
children.translated_text: (Upj(J) 24.20-25; ~ Skt.C 52 v4-53 r1; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 a3-b1; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 214.8-12)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.2.4
'Without actually having attained the first <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation), the second, the third, the fourth <s>dhyāna</s>; <s>maitrī</s> (loving-kindness), <s>karuṇā</s> (compassion), <s>muditā</s> (sympathetic joy), <s>upekṣā</s> (equanimity); the base of infinite space,

Uj III.ii.2.4.2.5
anarhann eva sann arhann aham asmy aṣṭavimokṣadhyāyīty ātmānaṃ pratijānīte 'nyatrā

children.translated_text: out of overestimation.' (Upj(J) 24.25-25.1; ~ Skt.C 53 r1; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b1)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.2.5
'Not actually being an <s>Arhat</s>, he claims "I am an <s>Arhat</s>, one who meditates on the eight <s>vimokṣas</s> (liberations)" — except

body.text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.3.1
evaṃrūpaṃ bhikṣuḥ sthānam adhyāpadya sahādhyāpa

children.text: tyā abhikṣur bhavaty aśramaṇo 'śākyaputrīyo dhvasyate bhikṣubhāvād dhatam asya bhavati śrāmaṇyaṃ dhvastaṃ mathitaṃ patitaṃ parājitam apratyuddhāryam asya bhavati śrāmaṇyaṃ (Upj(J) 25.1-3; ~ Skt.C 53 r1-3; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b1-2)
children.translated_text: into it, ceases to be a <s>bhikṣu</s>, ceases to be an ascetic, ceases to be a son of the <s>Śākyas</s>. He is destroyed from the state of being a <s>bhikṣu</s>; his <s>śrāmaṇya</s> (asceticism) is destroyed, crushed, shattered, fallen, defeated; his <s>śrāmaṇya</s> is irrecoverable." (Upj(J) 25.1-3; ~ Skt.C 53 r1-3; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b1-2)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.3.1
"A <s>bhikṣu</s> who has fallen into such a situation, by the very act of falling

body.text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.3.2
tadyathā tālo mastakāc chinnaḥ abhavyo haritatvāya abhavyo virūḍhiṃ vṛddhiṃ vipulatām āpattuṃ (Upj(J) 25.4-5; ~ Skt.C 53 r3-4; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b2-3)
body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.3.2
"Just as a palm tree cut at the crown is incapable of becoming green again, incapable of sprouting, growing, or becoming abundant —" (Upj(J) 25.4-5; ~ Skt.C 53 r3-4; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b2-3)

body.text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.4
evam eva bhikṣur evaṃrūpaṃ sthānam adhyāpadya yāvad apratyuddhāryam asya bhavati śrāmaṇyaṃ atra te 'dyāgreṇānadhyācāre 'nadhyāpattāv anadhyācāravairamaṇyāṃ tīvraś cetasa ārakṣā smṛtyapramāde yogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ (Upj(J) 25.5-7; ~ Skt.C 53 r4-5; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b3-5)
body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.4
"So too a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has fallen into such a situation — his <s>śrāmaṇya</s> is irrecoverable. From today onwards, you must make a vigorous effort in guarding the mind, in mindfulness and non-heedlessness, so as not to engage in such misconduct, not to fall into such an offense, and to abstain from such misconduct." (Upj(J) 25.5-7; ~ Skt.C 53 r4-5; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b3-5)

body.text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.5
kaccid evaṃrūpaṃ sthānaṃ nādhyāpatsyase tena vaktavyaṃ nādhyāpatsye (Upj(J) 25.7-8; ~ Skt.C 53 r5; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b5)
body.translated_text:
Uj III.ii.2.4.5
"Will you not fall into such a situation?" He should say: "I shall not fall into such a situation." (Upj(J) 25.7-8; ~ Skt.C 53 r5; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 27 b5)

body.text:
Uj III.iii.1
tataḥ paścāc catvāraḥ śramaṇakarakā dharmā ārocayitavyāḥ evañ ca punar ārocayitavyāḥ śṛṇu tvam āyuṣmaṃś catvāra ime tena bhagavatā jānatā paśyatā tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena

children.translated_text: declared for a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has thus gone forth and received full ordination

children.text: śramaṇakarakā dharmā ākhyātāḥ katame catvāraḥ (Upj(J) 25.10-13; ~ Skt.C 53 r5-7; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 a3-4)
children.translated_text: as the <s>śramaṇakaraka dharmas</s> (ascetic-making qualities). What are the four? (Upj(J) 25.10-13; ~ Skt.C 53 r5-7; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 a3-4)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.iii.1
Thereafter the four <s>śramaṇakaraka dharmas</s> (ascetic-making qualities) should be announced. And they should be announced thus: "Listen, Venerable One. These four [qualities] were by that <s>Bhagavān</s>, the knowing and seeing <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One,

body.text:
Uj III.iii.2
adyāgreṇa te āyuṣmann ākruṣṭena na pratyākroṣitavyaṃ

children.translated_text: when angered, you must not retaliate with anger;

children.text: tāḍitena na pratitāḍayitavyaṃ bhaṇḍitena na pratibhaṇḍayitavyaṃ kaccid evaṃrūpaṃ sthānaṃ nādhyāpatsyase tena vaktavyaṃ nādhyāpatsye (Upj(J) 25.13-16; ~ Skt.C 53r7-v1; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 a4-5; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 216.2-3, 288.9-10)
children.translated_text: when struck, you must not strike back; when quarreled with, you must not quarrel back. Will you not fall into such a condition?" He should say: "I shall not fall." (Upj(J) 25.13-16; ~ Skt.C 53r7-v1; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 a4-5; ŚrBh(T: re-ed) I 216.2-3, 288.9-10)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.iii.2
"From this day forward, Venerable One, when abused, you must not abuse in return;

body.text:
Uj III.iv.1
śṛṇu tvam āyuṣman yas te 'bhūt pūrvam āśāsakaḥ kaccid ahaṃ labheya svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣubhāvaṃ sa tvam etarhi pravrajita upasaṃpannaḥ pratirūpeṇopādhyāyena pratirūpābhyām ācāryābhyā

children.text: samagreṇa saṃghena jñapticaturthena karmaṇā akopyenāsthāpanārheṇa (Upj(J) 25.17-20; ~ Skt.C 53 v1-4; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 a5-b1)
children.translated_text: by a complete <s>Saṃgha</s>, through a <s>jñapticaturtha karman</s> (motion with fourth proclamation), which is incontestable and not subject to being set aside. (Upj(J) 25.17-20; ~ Skt.C 53 v1-4; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 a5-b1)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.iv.1
"Listen, Venerable One. That which was formerly your wish — 'May I obtain, in the well-proclaimed <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>, going forth, full ordination, and the state of a <s>bhikṣu</s>' — you have now gone forth and received full ordination, with a proper preceptor, with proper teachers

body.text:
Uj III.iv.2
yatra varṣaśatopasaṃpannena bhikṣuṇā śikṣāyāṃ śikṣitavyaṃ tatra tadaha upasaṃpannena

children.translated_text: where one ordained today must train,

children.text: tatra varṣaśatopasaṃpannena iti yātra samānaśīlatā samānaśikṣatā samānaprātimokṣasūtroddeśatā sā te 'dyāgreṇārāgayitavyā na virāgayitavyā (Upj(J) 25.20-26.1; ~ Skt.C 53 v4-6; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 b1-3)
children.translated_text: there one ordained for a hundred years must also train. This equality in moral conduct, equality in training, equality in the recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> — from this day forward you must cherish it, not become disenchanted with it. (Upj(J) 25.20-26.1; ~ Skt.C 53 v4-6; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 b1-3)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.iv.2
"Where a <s>bhikṣu</s> ordained for a hundred years must train in the training, there one ordained today must also train;

body.text:
Uj III.iv.3
adyāgreṇa te upādhyā

children.text: syāntike pitṛsaṃjñā upasthāpayitavyā upādhyāyenāpi tavāntike putrasaṃjñā upasthāpayitavyā / adyāgreṇa te upādhyāyo yāvajjīvam upasthātavyaḥ upādhyāyenāpi tvaṃ glānaḥ upasthātavyaḥ āmaraṇāya vāvyutthānāya vā (Upj(J) 26.1-4; ~ Skt.C 53 v6-54 r1; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 b3-5)
children.translated_text: you must maintain the perception of a father; and the preceptor must maintain the perception of a son toward you. From this day forward, you must attend upon your preceptor for as long as you live; and the preceptor must attend upon you when you are ill, until death or until disrobing. (Upj(J) 26.1-4; ~ Skt.C 53 v6-54 r1; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 b3-5)

body.translated_text:
Uj III.iv.3
"From this day forward, toward your preceptor

body.text: Uj III.iv.4

children.text: adyāgreṇa te sagauraveṇa vihartavyaṃ sapratīśena sabhayavaśavartinā sabrahmacāriṣu sthavireṣu madhyeṣu navakeṣu / (Upj(J) 26.4-6; ~ Skt.C 54 r1-2; vgl. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 b5-(32 a1))
children.translated_text: "From this day forward, you must conduct yourself with respect, with deference, with obedient submission toward your fellow celibates — elders, middle-ranking, and newly ordained. (Upj(J) 26.4-6; ~ Skt.C 54 r1-2; cf. Kṣudr-v(Bhī) 31 b5-(32 a1))

body.translated_text: Uj III.iv.4

body.text: Uj III.iv.5

children.text: adyāgreṇa te uddeṣṭavyaṃ paṭhitavyaṃ svādhyāyitavyaṃ skandhakauśalaṃ karaṇīyaṃ dhātukauśalam āyatanakauśalaṃ pratītyasamutpādakauśalaṃ sthānāsthānakauśalam* / dhurā ca te na nikṣeptavyā aprāptasya prāptaye anadhigatasyādhigamāya asākṣātkṛtasya sākṣātkriyāyai (Upj(J) 26.7-10; ~ Skt.C 54 r2-4)
children.translated_text: "From this day forward, you must recite, study, and practice self-recitation. You must develop skill in the <s>skandhas</s> (aggregates), skill in the <s>dhātus</s> (elements), skill in the <s>āyatanas</s> (sense-bases), skill in <s>pratītyasamutpāda</s> (dependent origination), skill in what is possible and what is impossible. And the burden must not be set down — for the attainment of what has not yet been attained, for the realization of what has not yet been realized, for the direct experience of what has not yet been directly experienced. (Upj(J) 26.7-10; ~ Skt.C 54 r2-4)

body.translated_text: Uj III.iv.5

body.text:
Uj III.iv.6
imāni ca te mayā audārikaudārikāṇi śikṣāpadāny ākhyātāni anyāni cānvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśa uddiśyamāne śroṣyasi anyāni ca te ācāryopādhyāyā grāhayiṣyanti samānopādhyāyaḥ samānācāryaḥ ālaptakās saṃlaptakāḥ saṃstutakāḥ sapremakāḥ (Upj(J) 26.11-14; ~ Skt.C 54 r4-7)
body.translated_text:
Uj III.iv.6
"These are the grosser training rules that I have declared to you. The rest you will hear when the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> is recited every half-month. And the rest your teachers and preceptors will teach you, as well as those with the same preceptor, those with the same teacher, those who have conversed with you, those who have discussed with you, those who have praised you, and those who are dear to you. (Upj(J) 26.11-14; ~ Skt.C 54 r4-7)

body.text:
Uj III.iv.7
eṣa tvam upasaṃpanno varaprajñasya śāsane /
yathemāṃ na virāgayasi durlabhāṃ kṣaṇasaṃpadaṃ
prāsādikasya pravrajyā pariśuddhasyopasaṃpadā
ākhyātā satyanāmnā vai saṃbuddhena prajānatā
body.translated_text:
Uj III.iv.7
"Thus you have received full ordination in the teaching of the One of Supreme Wisdom.
May you not become disenchanted with this rare and auspicious opportunity.
The going forth of the faithful one, the ordination of the purified one,
has been declared by the Perfectly Awakened One, the Wise, whose name is Truth.

body.text: eṣa tvam āyuṣman upasaṃpanno 'pramādena saṃpādaya (Upj(J) 26.15- 27.3; ~ Skt.C 54 r7-v2)
body.translated_text: "Thus you, Venerable One, have received full ordination. Accomplish [your purpose] with diligence." (Upj(J) 26.15-27.3; ~ Skt.C 54 r7-v2)
